construction.implementation_origin: New isolated reference implementation using clearly labeled synthetic fixtures

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version, synthetic=true, items, documents, events, fields, query, config. Items have id, categories, popularity in [0,1], document_ids; documents have id, title, text; events have item_id, kind=browse|purchase, nonnegative age_days. Fields have name, pattern with exactly one capturing group, type=string|number, required boolean. Config has positive half_life_days, max_items and max_findings.
shared_schema.output: One envelope: schema_version, status=ok, validated input, behavior, extraction, research. Errors use status=error and error message with exit code 2.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate(value, stage) validates original input and stage boundaries, references, counts, ranking ordering, exact source citations, extracted field types and values, missing-field reports, and research provenance.
shared_schema.citations: document_id, start (inclusive), end (exclusive), quote. Offsets count Python Unicode code points in original document text.

cross_stage_handoffs: Behavior selects ranked items and deduplicated document_ids; extraction validates and processes exactly those documents in that order.

Extraction provides typed fields, citations, missing fields and conversion diagnostics. Research validates these records, restricts retrieval to their documents, and links fields whose spans are contained in each finding.

behavior.ranking: Event weight = (purchase:3, browse:1) * 2^(-age_days/half_life_days). Weight is distributed equally across event item categories. Candidate score sums matching category weights plus 0.25 times its direct event weights. Item id breaks ties.
behavior.cold_start: No positive event weights, including fully decayed histories: rank by popularity, then item id. Empty catalogs are valid.
behavior.extraction: Case-sensitive regex patterns use the first match and exactly one capture group. Preserve string values; convert numbers to finite floats. Absent/blank captures are missing; invalid numeric captures additionally report errors. Missing required fields do not stop research.
behavior.research: Deterministic sentence-like passage splitting at periods, exclamation marks, question marks and newlines. Casefolded Unicode word-token overlap divided by query token count; positive-score passages only. Ties sort by document id then source offset. Findings are exact source text, not generated assertions.
behavior.determinism: No clock, random source, network, model, or external dependency.

excluded: Live providers or optional LLM execution
Language-aware sentence segmentation or decimal-aware splitting

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object with status ok
test_outcomes.error_behavior: Missing files and invalid usage verified in subprocesses; malformed JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite JSON and schema failures verified through CLI main.
